tool.name: krepp sketch
tool.description: create a sketch from a single FASTA/Q file

param.name: input
param.label: Input sequences
param.help: FASTA or FASTQ file containing reference sequences to sketch

tool.help:
**What it does**
Creates a krepp sketch from a single FASTA/Q file. The sketch is a compact binary representation of the k-mer content of the input sequences, which can be used for fast one-to-one distance estimation with `krepp seek`.
**Input**
A FASTA or FASTQ file containing reference sequences (e.g., a genome assembly or a metagenomic sample).
**Output**
A binary sketch file that can be used as input to `krepp seek`.
@ATTRIBUTION@
